providers.label: mevblocker-rpc
providers.log_window_basis: Run 36636132821 falsified the prior 10,000-block assumption: one historical account-log request exceeded mevblocker's 10,000-result cap and the endpoint proposed a 7,447-block maximum range. Use 5,000 blocks, below that observed bound; a failed range still fails closed and is never read as empty.

providers.label: tenderly-public
providers.log_window_basis: Probe run 36590720390 served 10,000-block account-log windows (1,937 logs) in 0.6 s; half of that window bounds the densest measured windows below about 4,300 logs per response. Batching is not supported.
